item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00188","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C24","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 is the governing comprehensive rewrite of the Civil Service Rules that the child directly extends by adding Rule VIII. The child closely reuses C08's machinery: Commission-authorized appointments outside ordinary competitive requirements, temporary or indefinite tenure, denial of competitive status, and Commission-prescribed qualifications and conditions. C24 is also a strong subsidiary textual source, especially for the retirement exclusion attached to nonpermanent appointments, but C08 supplies the clearest structural framework for the new rule. C07 contains related earlier rule architecture but is weaker because C08 supersedes and expands it.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"RULE VIII—APPOINTMENTS TO OVERSEAS POSITIONS ... the Commission may, by the regulations prescribed by it, authorize the recruitment and appointment of persons","parent_excerpt":"The Commission may determine the types, duration, and conditions of indefinite and temporary appointments, and may prescribe the method for replacing persons holding such appointments.","explanation":"Both place authority in the Commission to define and administer special appointment categories through regulations."},{"child_excerpt":"Such appointments shall be of temporary or indefinite duration, and shall not confer the right to acquire a competitive status.","parent_excerpt":"Tenure shall be granted and governed by the type of appointment ... without regard to whether he has a competitive status ... [and] such persons shall not acquire competitive status by reason of such appointment.","explanation":"The child combines C08's distinct concepts of temporary or indefinite tenure and appointments that do not confer competitive status."},{"child_excerpt":"United States citizens may be recruited overseas for appointment to overseas positions in the competitive service without regard to the competitive requirements of the Civil Service Act.","parent_excerpt":"Appointments without competitive examination in rare cases ... the Commission may authorize an appointment in the competitive service without competitive examination","explanation":"The operative mechanism is substantially the same—Commission-authorized appointment into the competitive service without the usual competitive examination—adapted to overseas recruitment."},{"child_excerpt":"Persons serving under appointments made pursuant to this section are hereby excluded from the operation of the Civil Service Retirement Act ... unless eligible for retirement benefits by continuity of service or otherwise.","parent_excerpt":"Persons given nonpermanent appointments pursuant to section 1 of this order are hereby excluded from the operation of the Civil Service Retirement Act ... unless eligible for retirement benefits by continuity of service or by reinstatement, or otherwise.","explanation":"This near-verbatim clause appears in C24 and shows that the child also drew a concrete subsidiary template from that earlier special-appointment order."}]}
